note: Educational alert rules. A flag means 'assess urgently', never 'diagnosis made'. Absence of a flag is NOT reassurance.

flags.text: Chest pain with features suggesting acute coronary syndrome: urgent ECG and senior review
Sudden tearing chest pain to the back: consider aortic dissection
Thunderclap / worst-ever headache: consider subarachnoid haemorrhage
Headache after head injury or on anticoagulants: consider intracranial bleed
Fever with neck stiffness or altered consciousness: consider meningitis/encephalitis/sepsis
Sudden breathlessness with VTE risk or pleuritic pain/haemoptysis: consider pulmonary embolism
Abdominal pain with missed period: exclude ectopic pregnancy urgently
Thoughts of self-harm or suicide: assess risk and safety now
